hint.month: Average monthly pay over the last 3 months. Add 3/12 of annual bonuses and leave allowances for accuracy.
hint.year: Annual salary ÷ 12 is used as monthly pay, divided by the days in the last 3 months.
hint.day: Enter the base daily wage (average daily wage) given by the job center.

hours.label: Scheduled hours per day
hours.hint: For part-timers the minimum benefit is prorated by hours (the 4-hour minimum rule was abolished in Dec 2023).

elig.title: Eligibility check
elig.insured: Do you have 180+ insured (paid) days in the 18 months before leaving?
elig.insuredHint: Insured days count paid days (incl. weekly paid holidays), not calendar days. With a 5-day week this takes roughly 7+ months.

reasonHint.involuntary: Dismissal, redundancy, contract expiry, closure, retirement age, etc.
reasonHint.just: Check the reasons that apply (Enforcement Rule, Annex 2)
reasonHint.voluntary: Personal reasons such as a job change, study or starting a business are generally not eligible

just.title: Justified reasons (check all that apply)
items: Unpaid wages: 2+ months of full or 30%+ unpaid wages within the last year, or pay below minimum wage
Working conditions worse than promised at hiring
Overtime above the 52-hour weekly limit for 2+ months within the last year
Workplace harassment or sexual harassment
Commute of 3+ hours round trip due to relocation, transfer or moving to live with a spouse
Illness, injury or lack of stamina and the employer refused leave or reassignment (medical note needed)
A family member needs 30+ days of care and leave was refused
Pregnancy, childbirth or childcare (child aged 8 or under) leave was refused
Company closure is certain or mass layoffs are planned

statusDesc.likely: You meet the 180-day and involuntary-leave requirements. Just check the reason code on the separation certificate.
statusDesc.check: The job center decides on justified reasons. Prepare pay slips, medical notes, commute proof, etc. Amounts below assume approval.
statusDesc.unlikely: Under 180 insured days or quitting for personal reasons is generally not eligible. If you had a justified reason, choose that option and check the items. Amounts below assume eligibility.

result.floorOverCap: For leaving in {year}, the minimum based on that year's minimum wage ({wage}) is {floor}, above the current cap of {cap}, so the minimum is paid regardless of wage (Employment Insurance Act Art. 46(2)). This may change if the cap (Enforcement Decree Art. 68) is amended.

basis.title: Show calculation
basis.note: If the average wage is below the ordinary wage, the ordinary wage is used. Rounding may cause small differences.

sched.title: Estimated payment schedule
sched.note: Assumes you apply the day after leaving. The 1st recognition is set 2 weeks after applying, then every 4 weeks; the job center sets the actual dates (weekends/holidays move to the next business day). Payment usually arrives within a few days. The benefit period is 12 months from the day after leaving (until the day before {expire}), so applying late can forfeit remaining days.

early.title: Early re-employment allowance
early.desc: If you get a job with at least half of your benefit days left and stay 12+ months, you receive half of the remaining benefit as a lump sum. With current inputs you must be re-employed by benefit day {last} (around {date}).
early.notEligible: Less than half remaining — not eligible
early.note: You must be re-employed after the 7-day waiting period and apply after 12 months of employment. Re-hiring by your former employer does not qualify.

table.title: Benefit days table
table.desc: Determined by age on leaving and insured period (Employment Insurance Act Art. 50, Annex 1). Your selection is highlighted.
table.head: Age / insured period

steps.title: How to apply
items: Check on Work24 that your employer filed the separation certificate and loss-of-coverage report, and that the reason code matches.
Register as a job seeker on Work24 (work24.go.kr).
Complete the online orientation for benefit applicants on Work24.
Visit your local job center with ID and apply for eligibility.
The first 7 days are an unpaid waiting period; attend the 1st recognition date set by the center.
Then report job-search activity about every 4 weeks (online available) and get paid within a few days.

know.title: Key facts
items: Daily benefit = 60% of the average wage over the last 3 months. 2026 cap 68,100 KRW, minimum 66,048 KRW (8 h).
Benefit days range from 120 to 270. Those 50+ or disabled get 30 more days with 1+ year of coverage.
You need 180 insured days within 18 months; multiple jobs are combined.
The benefit period is 12 months from the day after leaving; applying late loses remaining days.
Job-seeking benefits are not subject to income tax.

extended.title: Additional benefits
items: Early re-employment allowance: half of remaining benefits if re-employed with half or more left and kept 12 months
Training extension: up to 2 years at 100% during job-center-directed training
Individual extension: up to 60 days at 70% for severe hardship
Special extension: up to 60 days at 70% when designated by the Minister during mass unemployment
Wide-area job search and relocation expenses

caution.title: Cautions
items: Report any part-time or short-term work at recognition. Hiding it is fraud: repayment plus an extra charge (usually up to the amount received, up to 5x if colluding with the employer) and criminal penalties.
Those newly hired after age 65 (unless continuously employed since before 65) are not covered.
Dismissal for serious misconduct may restrict benefits.
Reductions for repeat recipients (3+ claims in 5 years) are a pending bill and not in effect as of October 2026.
This calculator is for reference; the job center's decision is final.

items.q: Can I get benefits after a recommended resignation?
items.a: Yes, if it was due to business reasons such as downsizing. Check that the separation reason code is 23 (business necessity/downsizing, incl. dismissal and recommended resignation). Resignation or dismissal due to your own fault (26) may be restricted.

items.q: Where can I see my separation reason code?
items.a: Log in to Work24 and check your insured-status history. Common codes: 11 personal reasons, 12 quit due to changed conditions or unpaid wages, 22 closure, 23 business necessity, 26 dismissal for fault, 31 retirement age, 32 contract end. If incorrect, ask the employer to correct it or submit proof to the job center.
The employer files it with the job center within 10 days of the center's request. Asking your employer to file early speeds things up.

items.q: Am I eligible when my fixed-term contract ends?
items.a: Yes, contract expiry is involuntary. But refusing a renewal offer on equal or better terms may be treated as voluntary.

items.q: Do I need to apply right away?
items.a: The benefit period is 12 months from the day after leaving. Days not received within it are forfeited, so apply as soon as possible.
A bill to cut benefits by up to 50% for 3+ claims in 5 years is pending but had not passed as of October 2026.
